name: Blue Dot Farm
tagline: About Blue Dot Farm — Blue Dot Farm
description: Blue Dot Farm is an on-farm market in 21010 Se 416th Street, WA, selling produce straight from the field. Because everything is sold where it is grown, selection follows the local harvest calendar. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
